description: This is a web application's front-end source file defining the user interface for a database viewer. It contains HTML, embedded CSS styles, and JavaScript code to interact with backend API endpoints to fetch and display databases, tables, and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading from the backend API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables and loads table list if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders an HTML table from dataset, handling wide content and large objects.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, with expansion for long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or JSON objects.
